D.quote: In 2018, Major Star was diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer linked to burn pit exposure and was medically retired before reaching 20 years of service.

It is simply wrong that our combat-injured veterans are forced to choose between the retirement pay they earned through years of service and the disability compensation they deserve for the sacrifices they made.
During his four years of service, Tom worked on construction projects and built water holding tanks for places that didn’t have clean drinking water.

R.quote: David E. McFerrin, Filer: American Legion Post 47 of Filer nominated David McFerrin, who retired from the U.S. Army after 40 years of service.

Under current law, some combat-injured veterans medically retired with fewer than 20 years of service are prevented from receiving both their full military retirement pay and VA disability compensation.

Major Richard Star Act: legislation that eliminates the “wounded veteran tax,” allowing eligible combat-injured veterans who were medically retired before completing 20 years of service to receive both their full military retirement pay and VA disability compensation without a reduction in benefits.

D.quote: The bill now goes to the House of Representatives, and if passed, would go to the President’s desk.
I urge the Senate to swiftly take up this legislation and send it to the President’s desk to honor our contract to our veterans who served our nation with dedication and love of country.
I urge my colleagues in the House to support this bill and send it to the president’s desk.

R.quote: I call upon our Republican leadership in Congress to immediately send bills to the President's desk that reflect the will of the American people, such as the Coercion and Sexual Abuse Free Environment Act (a bipartisan bill protecting children from online predators), the Monitor Accountability Act (also a bipartisan bill to set clear rules for courts' use of federal monitors), and the Colorado River Basin Infrastructure Act (necessary to preserve the Colorado River for all Basin states).
Senator Budd’s Hurricane Forecast Improvement Program Enhancement Act and Radar Next Program Act were included in the final Weather Act package, which is now headed to the President’s desk.
In light of this agreement, it is anticipated that the House of Representatives will take up and send the Weather Act to the President’s desk before the end of the 119th Congress.

D.quote: Helping develop and pass into law the PACT Act, which fundamentally reforms and improves how veterans exposed to toxic substances receive health care and benefits from the VA.
Cut Red Tape for Iran War veterans by statutorily presuming toxic substance exposure for Iran War Veterans, helping streamline their access to health care and benefits at VA.
The PACT Act delivered VA health care and benefits to all generations of toxic-exposed veterans, and their survivors, for the first time in our nation’s history.

R.quote: Beyond the Major Richard Star Act, the Take Care of America’s Veterans Act delivers more than 60 Veterans priorities, including improvements to VA health care and benefits, and expanded support for survivors and caregivers.

The bill is a comprehensive legislative package containing more than 60 bills to modernize the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), improve veterans’ access to health care and benefits, and strengthen the support system their caregivers, survivors, and families rely on every day.
Both measures aim to ensure America’s veterans receive the care and benefits they’ve earned through their service and sacrifice.
